register.labelZh: FADE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fade in 和 fade out 可用來描述音樂、聲音和畫面逐漸出現或消失。；fade away 可用來描述恐懼、痛楚、記憶、氣味和腳步聲逐漸變弱並消失。；fade out 可表示抗議活動、宣傳活動、爭論或話題逐漸失去影響,最後消失。；剪接聲音或畫面時,fade something in 和 fade something out 都十分實用。
register.summaryEn: Fade in and fade out help you describe music, voices and pictures appearing or disappearing slowly. Fade away helps you describe fear, pain, memories, smells and footsteps becoming weaker and disappearing. Fade out can show that a protest, campaign, argument or topic slowly becomes less important and disappears. Fade something in and fade something out are useful when people edit sound or pictures.
